papers.title: Effect of Heat Treatment on Microstructure and Properties of Laser Powder Bed Fusion–Fabricated High‐strength and High‐toughness Alloy
papers.abstract: To address low material utilization, high costs, and lengthy production cycles associated with traditional processing of high‐strength titanium alloys, this study investigates the effects of postheat treatment on the microstructure and properties of Ti‐3Al‐8V‐6Cr‐4Mo‐4Zr (Ti‐38644) titanium alloy fabricated by laser powder bed fusion (PBF‐LB). Ti‐38644 powder is used to prepare specimens via PBF‐LB. Various solution and aging treatments are applied, and the resulting changes are analyzed using optical microscopy, scanning electron microscopy, transmission electron microscopy, X‐ray diffraction, and room‐temperature tensile testing. Solution treatment eliminates molten pool boundaries and substructures in the PBF‐LB‐formed Ti‐38644, increases XRD peak intensity, reduces dislocation density, and enhanced plasticity—elongation increased from 11.9% to 15.5%. Aging induced precipitation of the secondary α phase, increasing strength to 1510 ± 2 MPa. Raising the aging temperature from 500°C to 600°C transformed the α phases from fine acicular to coarse lamellar morphologies, reduced their quantity, decreases strength, and improves plasticity—elongation increased from 4.25 ± 2.5% to 15.5 ± 3.5%. This study is anticipated to provide valuable data and technical support for the engineering application of PBF‐LB‐fabricated Ti‐38644 alloy components in aerospace and related fields.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了激光粉末床熔融Ti-38644合金的热处理对微观结构和力学性能的影响，但未涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡、疲劳性能或生物医学应用。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structures, stress shielding, fatigue testing, or biomedical implant context; it focuses on heat treatment of a high-strength titanium alloy for aerospace applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决传统加工高强钛合金材料利用率低、成本高的问题
summary_zh.method: 对激光粉末床熔融Ti-38644合金进行固溶和时效热处理，分析微观结构和拉伸性能
summary_zh.result: 固溶处理提高塑性，时效处理通过析出α相提高强度至1510 MPa
summary_zh.validation: 通过光学显微镜、SEM、TEM、XRD和室温拉伸测试验证

summary_en.motivation: To overcome low material utilization and high costs of conventional processing for high-strength titanium alloys.
summary_en.method: Post-heat treatments (solution and aging) were applied to Ti-38644 alloy fabricated by laser powder bed fusion, and microstructural evolution and tensile properties were characterized.
summary_en.result: Solution treatment increased elongation from 11.9% to 15.5%, while aging at 500°C yielded a maximum strength of 1510 MPa due to secondary α phase precipitation.
summary_en.validation: Microstructural analysis (OM, SEM, TEM, XRD) and room-temperature tensile testing were performed.
